articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process video streams, codebases, and audio in a single context window of up to 1 million tokens. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-Bench over GPT-4.5, with notably stronger performance on multi-file refactoring and architectural reasoning tasks. The model is available via API with a new streaming mode optimized for real-time agent workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored a gold-medal-equivalent 94% on a curated set of International Mathematical Olympiad problems, surpassing all previous AI systems. The model uses a novel chain-of-verification architecture that cross-checks intermediate proof steps against a formal theorem-proving backend. Researchers say the approach could accelerate automated discovery in pure mathematics and theoretical physics.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in three of its U.S. Gigafactories for tasks including parts sorting, quality inspection, and bin picking. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and an on-device vision-language model for understanding natural-language task instructions. Tesla reports a 4x improvement in mean-time-between-failures compared to Gen 2 prototypes shown earlier this year.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Sim-to-Real Learning Pipeline
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform, backed by a fully integrated sim-to-real reinforcement learning pipeline that allows customers to train custom locomotion and manipulation skills in simulation and deploy them within hours. The system leverages a photorealistic digital twin environment built on NVIDIA Omniverse. Early enterprise partners in logistics and construction report 60% reductions in task-programming time compared to traditional motion-planning approaches.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' for Enterprise-Grade AI Safety Guardrails
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new framework called Constitutional Classifiers, a modular safety layer that sits between LLM outputs and end users, applying learned constitutional principles to detect and mitigate harmful, biased, or policy-violating content in real time. The system is trained adversarially and reduced jailbreak success rates to under 1% in red-team evaluations while maintaining a less than 3% false-positive rate on benign queries. The framework ships as an open-weight toolkit for enterprise integration.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced the start of volume production on its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, delivering a 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction over its 2nm node. The first customers are expected to be Apple and NVIDIA for next-generation mobile SoCs and AI accelerators shipping in 2027. Industry analysts note this cements TSMC's lead over Samsung Foundry and Intel, which are still ramping their comparable nodes.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuit with 100+ Logical Qubits
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly demonstrated a fault-tolerant quantum computation using over 100 logical qubits with error rates below the threshold needed for practical quantum advantage on certain optimization problems. The system combines Quantinuum's trapped-ion hardware with Microsoft's topological error-correction codes. While general-purpose quantum supremacy remains distant, the milestone opens the door to near-term applications in materials simulation and cryptographic research.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Production for Warehouse Automation
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and Jeff Bezos' Explore Investments, valuing the company at $12 billion. The funding will be used to build a dedicated manufacturing facility in Texas and scale production of its Figure 03 humanoid to thousands of units per year. Figure's robots are already piloting at BMW and Amazon fulfillment centers, performing unstructured pick-and-place and collaborative packing tasks alongside human workers.
